Twelve hands-on levels, a boss round, a step-through code viewer and a cheat sheet for building intuition about data structures, algorithms and Big-O.

## Download

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit | `BigOArcade-Windows.zip` |
| macOS 11 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel | `BigOArcade-macOS.zip` |

**macOS**

1. Unzip, then double-click **Big-O Arcade**.
2. The app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. macOS asks once to confirm you want to open an app downloaded from the internet.

**Windows**

1. Unzip, then double-click `BigOArcade.exe`.
2. The Windows build is not code-signed. If you see "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Prefer to run from source? Install [Godot 4](https://godotengine.org/download), clone the repository and run `godot --path .` instead.

Progress is saved on your machine. Nothing is sent anywhere.

## Changes

- **1.0.2** the macOS app is now signed and notarized, so it opens without the Gatekeeper workaround. Built with Godot 4.7.2.
- **1.0.1** fixes a crash that happened every time the game was closed.
- **1.0.0** first release.
